exposure: Time interval between spinal induction and skin incision
outcome: Hypotension after spinal anesthesia during cesarean section
cohort: 410 women undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia at Gandhi Memorial Hospital, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: The incidence of hypotension after spinal anesthesia was 64%, and factors associated with increased risk included newborn weight ≥4kg, baseline systolic blood pressure < 120mmHg, sensory block height >T6, time interval between spinal induction and skin incision > 6 minutes, and anesthetist experience.
